description.value: Katsu San is a modern Japanese restaurant in Richmond specializing in pork cutlet (tonkatsu) that is Koji-cured for 62 hours to maximize flavour and juiciness. The restaurant uses house-made bread crumbs and in-house sauces inspired by traditional Japanese recipes with a contemporary twist. The menu spans various katsu sets, champon ramen, and cold ramen, with dine-in and takeout options available.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands at 40m; rack at 63m; rack at 74m; rack at 82m.
